title: Kids' Halloween costumes 2026: superhero, anime, spooky and cute
seoTitle: Halloween Costumes for Kids Philippines 2026: Superhero, Anime, Spooky, Cute
dek: 30 kids' costumes in four moods: superhero, cartoon and anime, spooky-but-fun and cuddly-cute, picked for mall trick-or-treats and school costume days before October 31.
teaser: 30 kids' costumes in four moods, from capes and princess gowns to cuddly dinosaurs.
description: Halloween costume ideas for kids in the Philippines: superhero suits, cartoon and anime costumes, spooky witch and vampire sets, and cute dinosaur and unicorn costumes for trick-or-treat and school.

intro: Halloween falls on a Saturday this year, 31 October 2026, but for many kids the costume comes out sooner. Last year, malls and hotels around Metro Manila held kids' trick-or-treat parties and costume contests in the last weeks of October, and school costume days often land in the same stretch. Ordering now leaves time for delivery and a try-on at home before the big day.

We've grouped the picks into four looks so you can jump straight to what your child loves: superhero for little heroes, cartoon and anime for fans of their favourite shows, spooky for kids who like a friendly fright, and cute for toddlers and anyone who'd rather be adorable than scary. Check each pick's size chart before you add it to your cart.

curation.title: Well-reviewed, kid-friendly and ready for October 31

callouts.title: Measure first, then check the chart
callouts.body: Age ranges on listings are only a starting point, since sizes vary from shop to shop. Measure your child's height, chest and waist, then compare with the seller's size chart. Between sizes? Go up one, but make sure the hem won't drag on the floor.

callouts.title: About character costumes
callouts.body: Most character costumes here come from independent shops rather than official merchandise, and we say so on each card. If an official costume matters to your child, look for the licence details on the listing before you order.

tipGroups.title: Four tips for a happy, safe Halloween

tips.title: Check the fit, then order early
tips.body: Costumes and shoes should fit well, and hems should be short enough that your child won't trip or snag on things. Order early so there's time for a try-on at home before the event.

tips.title: Look for a flame-resistant label
tips.body: Check costume, mask and wig labels for "flame resistant". Skip big baggy sleeves and long capes around candles, and use flameless or battery lights in jack-o'-lanterns.

tips.title: Keep their view clear
tips.body: Masks can block a child's view, so face paint and a hat make a good swap. Make sure hats can't slide over the eyes, and add bright colors or reflective tape for walking after dark.

tips.title: Patch-test face paint first
tips.body: Test face paint at least 24 to 48 hours before the event by dabbing a little on your child's arm. If redness, a rash or swelling shows up there, it may be an allergy, so don't use it.

Look for "flame resistant" on the label, and keep capes and long skirts away from candles and lit jack-o'-lanterns.
Dark suits are hard to see at night, so add a strip of reflective tape or carry a glow stick for evening trick-or-treats.

Dark costumes are hard to see after sunset and loose fabric can catch fire, so add reflective tape and use battery lights, not candles.

extras.name: Pumpkin tunic and stem hat (3-9 yrs)
extras.label: Best for matching family
extras.note: An orange jack-o'-lantern tunic with a green leaf collar and a stem hat, listed for 3-9 yrs with adult sizes too, so a parent or sibling can match. Slips over a tee and shorts.

extras.name: Baby bee hooded romper (2 months-3 yrs)
extras.label: Sweetest for babies
extras.note: A navy-and-yellow striped romper with a hood and tiny antennae, for 2 months to 3 yrs. Short sleeves keep it cooler. The photo also shows bee booties, so check what's included.

extras.name: Bunny hooded jumpsuit, white or pink (3-9 yrs)
extras.label: Softest bunny look
extras.note: A plush hooded jumpsuit with long bunny ears, in white or pink, for 3-9 yrs. Cosy in air-conditioned malls; on hot days, put it on just before the event.
